transcription_note: French text from the LaTeX typesetting by Daniel Miller (https://github.com/dkmiller/sga4.5), with corrections based on the original publication, Lecture Notes in Mathematics 569, Springer-Verlag, 1977. The «Fil d'Ariane» (pp. 1–3), absent from that LaTeX source, is transcribed directly from the original publication. The per-exposé bibliographies (Exposés I, II, VI, and the appendix of Exposé VII) are likewise transcribed from the original publication, and the in-text citations restored to their printed form (per-exposé numbering, inline references with their locators), in place of the LaTeX source's consolidated end-of-book bibliography.
